purpose: Addendum to holdout_sel1m_train8m_v1, fixed before training: standard ParT on train8m_head with start LR 3e-3 (one member, otherwise as sel1m_train8m_standard_part), because there the best member had the highest start LR, 1e-3. The standard ParT (1e-3) and fast PBT checkpoints of holdout_sel1m_train8m_v1 are re-evaluated as references. The standard ParT result on 8M is the one of the two standard ParT checkpoints with the better sel1m_tail value; the holdout does not choose. Pairs: the 3e-3 checkpoint against the 1e-3 one, and the fast PBT against the 3e-3 one.
